newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Multi-Purpose buys remaining bank shares.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Purpose buys remaining bank shares.

text.p: Malaysian finance, gaming and property development conglomerate Multi-Purpose Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it planned to acquire the remaining shares in its banking and finance subsidiary which it does not own.
Multi-Purpose said in a statement it is offering to buy the remaining 23.6 percent stake in Multi-Purpose Capital Holdings Bhd at 2.60 ringgit per share.
The offer would involve a total cash consideration of 135.2 million ringgit, which would be raised from a combination of internally-generated funds and bank borrowings, it said.
Multi-Purpose Capital owns the group's commercial bank, Multi-Purpose Bank Bhd, as well as a finance company and an insurance company.
Multi-Purpose shares were unchanged at 4.06 ringgit at the midday close.
